sloka: तपनेन गजः सार्धं राक्षसेन महाबलः ।निकुम्भेन महातेजा नीलो ऽपि समयुद्ध्यत ।। ६.४३.९ ।।।।
transliteration: tapanena gajaḥ sārdhaṁ rākṣasena mahābalaḥ ।nikumbhena mahātejā nīlo 'pi samayuddhyata ।। 6.43.9 ।।।।

translations.english: Gaja of great strength fought with Rakshasa Tapa, and highly energetic Neela fought with Nikumbha.
